A practice session done offline on the device. The server checks every answer again;
the device's own marking is never trusted.

QuestionReport.description:
A learner flags a question (any origin) as wrong or unclear. The question goes back
to review.
QuestionReport.title: QuestionReport

QuestionUpdate.description: Reviewer edits. Only fields present are changed; null clears nullable fields.
QuestionUpdate.title: QuestionUpdate

QuickAnswer.description: A short AI answer to a search. Not stored and not checked by anyone.
QuickAnswer.title: QuickAnswer

RepeatCounts.description: How often something appeared in the learner's own papers.

SimilarGroup.description:
Questions worded alike (numbers ignored) in different papers. A suggestion based on
wording only, not a reviewed classification.
SimilarGroup.title: SimilarGroup

SyllabusDraftRead.description:
Subjects and topics read from a syllabus PDF. Nothing is saved: the learner keeps what
they want with POST /topics/bulk.
SyllabusDraftRead.title: SyllabusDraftRead

SyllabusSource.description: Where a saved draft came from: its topics form one section that can be removed.
SyllabusSource.title: SyllabusSource

TopicCreate.description: A learner's own topic for one exam (catalog or own).

TopicDraft.description:
An AI-proposed topic list for an exam. Nothing is saved: the learner edits it and saves
the topics they keep (POST /topics/bulk).

TopicsBulkCreate.description: Saving an accepted (and edited) topic draft in one step.
